text:
took my 2 kittens here they are kind and helpful. My cat had ingested a bunch of plastic i suspected because she was vomiting a bit but unfortunately they don't have the equipment to screen it. I wish that they could have induced the cat to vomit it out or something because I know that sometimes the plastic can damage their GI tract permanently. Luckily nothing bad happened. They diagnosed my kittens fever and gave injection and medicine. And helped clear ear mites from both my kittens. cost about 2300 for both kittens including medicines and injection.
But I'm not sure about the diagnosis because originally I said she was poisoned by plastic but the doctor said she has fever. Maybe she had both issues at that time I'm not sure. And today my kitten vomitted a lot of plastic, just like I said was the original problem. I wish they had taken my concern more seriously instead of only saying that the cat had Cat Flu and giving antibiotics. Anyways overall it's a great place and the doctors and staff care for the animals and are kind and professional people. I would have given 5* if they had all the equipment to do the diagnosis for the issue my cat had but 4* is a good score.
